# E-M5 III 1.7 in om-emu: stock c3d screens drawn

With the notes' patches, om-emu shows the vector-GPU layer and the camera's own c3d code draws the stock Color Creator, ART carousel and Part Color screens.

**emulator; reported pass; partial report; not applicable.**

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** notes' om-emu patch set (2026-11-21)

**Provenance:** maintainer summary. **Reported:** 2026-11-21. **Test date:** 2026-11-21.

**Reported/observed package SHA-256:** not recorded.

## Procedure and coverage

om-emu E137 with the notes' patches applied; the stock screens opened from the emulated menus and turned with the emulated dials; frames captured from the composited display.

- Stock Color Creator wheel drawn and redrawn as it turns.
- ART carousel and Part Color ring drawn by the camera's own c3d code.

Emulator: [https://github.com/flatpanda/om-emu](https://github.com/flatpanda/om-emu), revision `ccfe2e0`, model `E137`.

Stand-ins: The notes' om-emu patches (IMG plane compositing, generated live-view backdrop), A JavaScript OpenVG stand-in for the camera's GPU library (c3d runner).

## Limits and assumptions

- Emulator only; om-emu does not model the GPU, so drawing goes through a JavaScript OpenVG stand-in.
- The ART band height differs from the camera (about 80 px in om-emu, about 120 px on the camera, from an owner photo).
- Not a camera test.
